name: Sparklers
description: Hand-held sparklers in electric, colour and gold varieties.
safetyNotes: Hold at arm's length, pointing away from your face and from other people.
Light one sparkler at a time and never hand a lit sparkler to someone else.
Drop finished sparklers straight into a bucket of water – the wire stays hot for several minutes.

name: Flower Pots
description: Ground fountains that shower colourful sparks.
safetyNotes: Place on flat, firm ground in an open space before lighting.
Light the fuse from the side at arm's length and step back at least 5 metres.
Never hold a flower pot in your hand or lean over it.

name: Ground Chakkars
description: Spinning wheels that whirl on the ground.
safetyNotes: Use on a smooth, hard surface away from dry leaves and loose clothing.
Keep feet and children well back – chakkars can move unpredictably.
Do not pick up a chakkar until it has stopped and cooled.

name: Rockets
description: Sky rockets with colour, whistle and sound effects.
safetyNotes: Launch only from a bottle or tube placed on level ground, pointing straight up.
Use in wide open spaces, well away from buildings, wires, trees and vehicles.
Never point a rocket at people, animals or windows.

name: Single Sound Crackers
safetyNotes: Light at arm's length and move away immediately.
Never light crackers in your hand or inside containers.
Protect your ears and keep children at a safe distance.

name: Bombs
safetyNotes: For adults only. Keep children and pets well away.
Use only in open spaces, away from hospitals, homes and parked vehicles.
Light and step back at least 5 metres; never stand over a cracker that did not go off.

name: Garlands & Walas
safetyNotes: Unroll fully and lay flat on open ground – never hang from buildings or trees.
Light from the end at arm's length and walk away immediately.
Wait several minutes after the last burst before going near.

name: Aerial Shots
description: Multi-shot sky displays with colour bursts.
safetyNotes: Place on firm, level ground; weigh down the base if needed so it cannot tip over.
Keep the area above clear of wires, trees and roofs.
Stand at least 10 metres away and never look into the tube.

name: Fancy Fountains
safetyNotes: Set on a flat, stable surface in the open.
Light from the side and step back; sparks can travel several metres.
Do not try to relight a fountain that stops early – soak it in water.

name: Kids Specials
description: Low-noise novelty items for children under adult supervision.
safetyNotes: Children must always be supervised by an adult.
Snake tablets leave hot residue – do not touch until cool.
Keep matches and items away from the mouth and eyes.

name: Pencils & Twinklers
safetyNotes: Hold away from your body and keep clothing clear of sparks.
Light one at a time and stay in an open area.
Place used pencils in a bucket of water.

name: Gift Boxes
description: Assorted family and kids combo boxes.
safetyNotes: Each item in the box has its own safety instructions – read them before lighting.
Use only one item at a time and keep the box closed and away from sparks.
An adult should handle all lighting.
